events.title: Flemish militia defeat French knights at the Battle of the Golden Spurs
events.description: Flemish townsmen on foot routed the French cavalry at Courtrai, collecting hundreds of golden spurs from the dead. The battle showed that disciplined infantry could beat mounted knights.
events.html: Flemish townsmen on foot routed the French cavalry at Courtrai, collecting hundreds of golden spurs from the dead. The battle showed that disciplined infantry could beat mounted knights.

events.title: Charles of Luxembourg is elected King of the Romans
events.description: Five prince-electors meeting at Rhens chose Charles of Luxembourg as rival king to Louis IV. Later crowned emperor as Charles IV, he issued the Golden Bull of 1356 that fixed imperial elections for centuries.
events.html: Five prince-electors meeting at Rhens chose Charles of Luxembourg as rival king to Louis IV. Later crowned emperor as Charles IV, he issued the Golden Bull of 1356 that fixed imperial elections for centuries.

events.title: Congress re-establishes the US Marine Corps
events.description: An Act of Congress created the US Marine Corps as a permanent service, reviving the Continental Marines of the Revolution. It grew into one of America's most celebrated fighting forces.
events.html: An Act of Congress created the US Marine Corps as a permanent service, reviving the Continental Marines of the Revolution. It grew into one of America's most celebrated fighting forces.

events.title: Aaron Burr mortally wounds Alexander Hamilton in a duel
events.description: Vice President Aaron Burr shot Alexander Hamilton at Weehawken, New Jersey; Hamilton died the next day. The death of the first Treasury Secretary ended Burr's political career.
events.html: Vice President Aaron Burr shot Alexander Hamilton at Weehawken, New Jersey; Hamilton died the next day. The death of the first Treasury Secretary ended Burr's political career.

events.title: Babe Ruth makes his major league debut for the Red Sox
events.description: Nineteen-year-old Babe Ruth pitched for the Boston Red Sox against Cleveland, winning his first major league game. He went on to become baseball's greatest slugger and a symbol of the 1920s.
events.html: Nineteen-year-old Babe Ruth pitched for the Boston Red Sox against Cleveland, winning his first major league game. He went on to become baseball's greatest slugger and a symbol of the 1920s.

events.title: Skylab falls to Earth over Western Australia
events.description: NASA's Skylab space station broke up on re-entry, scattering debris near Esperance in Western Australia. The local shire jokingly fined NASA for littering; an American radio host paid the fine in 2009.
